//go:build js && wasm && !nextgo_module

package client

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
	"syscall/js"
	"testing"

	"github.com/Suhaibinator/Next.go/offline"
)

// These source-only tests exercise Go ownership transitions separately from
// native browser evidence. They are authored but not executed in this change.
func offlineAuthorityFixture(t *testing.T) *offlineController {
	t.Helper()
	c := &offlineController{
		descriptor:offline.ClientDescriptor{Version:1,Scope:"https://reader.test/reader",WorkerURL:"https://reader.test/reader/_nextgo/offline/sw.js",CatalogURL:"https://reader.test/reader/_nextgo/offline/catalog",OwnerPolicyID:"reader",RuntimeID:strings.Repeat("a",20),ConfigurationID:strings.Repeat("b",64)},
		state:OfflineState{Configured:true,Supported:true,Phase:"ready",Enabled:true},
	}
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	oldController, oldRealm, oldDocument, oldWindow := documentOffline, offlineRealmInUse, doc, win
	documentOffline, offlineRealmInUse = c, nil
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
		documentOffline, offlineRealmInUse, doc, win = oldController, oldRealm, oldDocument, oldWindow
		offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	})
	return c
}

func TestOfflineAuthorityConcurrentAdmissionHasOneWinner(t *testing.T) {
	c := offlineAuthorityFixture(t)
	c.diag.DiagnosticRevision = 41
	c.lastDisable.unregisterResolvedTrue = true
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	const attempts = 32
	start := make(chan struct{})
	results := make(chan error, attempts)
	for i := 0; i < attempts; i++ {
		go func() { <-start; _, err := offlineAdmitOperation(ctx,"disable"); results <- err }()
	}
	close(start)
	winners, refused := 0, 0
	for i := 0; i < attempts; i++ {
		switch err := <-results; err {
		case nil: winners++
		case ErrOfflineBusy: refused++
		default: t.Fatalf("unexpected admission result: %v",err)
		}
	}
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	busy, phase, receipt, diagnostic := c.busy, c.state.Phase, c.lastDisable, c.diag
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	if winners != 1 || refused != attempts-1 || !busy || phase != "disabling" {
		t.Fatalf("admission lost serialization: winners=%d refused=%d busy=%v phase=%q",winners,refused,busy,phase)
	}
	if receipt != (offlineDisableReceipt{}) || diagnostic.DiagnosticRevision != 42 || diagnostic.Operation != OfflineDiagnosticDisable || !diagnostic.Available {
		t.Fatalf("winner did not atomically reset receipt/begin exactly one diagnostic: receipt=%+v diagnostic=%+v",receipt,diagnostic)
	}
}

func TestOfflineAuthorityGlobalRealmBlocksReplacementAdmission(t *testing.T) {
	c := offlineAuthorityFixture(t)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	offlineRealmInUse = &offlineProofRealm{parent:offlineRealmParent{c:&offlineController{}}}
	c.lastDisable.unregisterResolvedTrue = true
	c.diag.DiagnosticRevision = 9
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	_, err := offlineAdmitOperation(ctx,"disable")
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	busy, receipt, revision := c.busy,c.lastDisable,c.diag.DiagnosticRevision
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	if err != ErrOfflineBusy || busy || !receipt.unregisterResolvedTrue || revision != 9 {
		t.Fatalf("replacement bypassed physical realm ownership: err=%v busy=%v receipt=%+v revision=%d",err,busy,receipt,revision)
	}
}

func TestOfflineAuthorityInitializerCannotConfigureReplacement(t *testing.T) {
	old := offlineAuthorityFixture(t)
	descriptor := old.descriptor
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	old.state = OfflineState{Phase:"unavailable"}
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	published := make(chan struct{})
	replacementCommitted := make(chan struct{})
	result := make(chan bool,1)
	replacement := &offlineController{state:OfflineState{Phase:"unavailable"}}
	go func() {
		close(published)
		<-replacementCommitted
		offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
		committed := offlineCommitConfigurationLocked(old,descriptor,true)
		offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
		result <- committed
	}()
	<-published
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	documentOffline = replacement
	currentCommit := offlineCommitConfigurationLocked(replacement,descriptor,false)
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	close(replacementCommitted)
	staleCommit := <-result
	snapshot := OfflineStatus()
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	oldConfigured, currentDescriptor := old.state.Configured,replacement.descriptor
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	if staleCommit || !currentCommit || oldConfigured || !snapshot.Configured || snapshot.Supported || currentDescriptor != descriptor || snapshot.Scope != descriptor.Scope || snapshot.OwnerPolicyID != descriptor.OwnerPolicyID {
		t.Fatalf("initializer replacement lost atomic configuration: stale=%v current=%v oldConfigured=%v snapshot=%+v",staleCommit,currentCommit,oldConfigured,snapshot)
	}
}

func TestOfflineAuthorityCanceledAdmissionKeepsFactsAndRevision(t *testing.T) {
	c := offlineAuthorityFixture(t)
	c.lastDisable.unregisterResolvedTrue = true
	c.diag.DiagnosticRevision = 8
	ctx,cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	cancel()
	_,err := offlineAdmitOperation(ctx,"disable")
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	busy,receipt,revision,phase := c.busy,c.lastDisable,c.diag.DiagnosticRevision,c.state.Phase
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	if err != ErrOfflineUnknown || busy || !receipt.unregisterResolvedTrue || revision != 8 || phase != "ready" {
		t.Fatalf("canceled non-admission changed attempt state: err=%v busy=%v receipt=%+v revision=%d phase=%q",err,busy,receipt,revision,phase)
	}
}

func TestOfflineAuthorityPublicationUsesWholeDescriptorAndRealm(t *testing.T) {
	for _, changed := range []string{"configuration","controller","document","window","canceled","support"} {
		t.Run(changed,func(t *testing.T) {
			c := offlineAuthorityFixture(t)
			ctx,cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
			defer cancel()
			a,err := offlineAdmitOperation(ctx,"disable")
			if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			if changed == "canceled" { cancel() }
			offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
			switch changed {
			case "configuration": c.descriptor.ConfigurationID = strings.Repeat("c",64)
			case "controller": documentOffline = &offlineController{}
			case "document": if doc.IsNull() { doc = js.Undefined() } else { doc = js.Null() }
			case "window": if win.IsNull() { win = js.Undefined() } else { win = js.Null() }
			case "support": c.state.Supported = false
			}
			before := c.state
			offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
			applied := a.apply(ctx,offlineReply{Supported:true,State:"disabled"})
			offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
			after,confirmed := c.state,c.confirmedDisabled
			offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
			if applied || after != before || confirmed { t.Fatalf("revoked %s published state: applied=%v before=%+v after=%+v confirmed=%v",changed,applied,before,after,confirmed) }
		})
	}
}

func TestOfflineAuthorityRequestReservationIsAtomicAndBounded(t *testing.T) {
	c := offlineAuthorityFixture(t)
	const count = 32
	reserved := make(chan uint64,count)
	errors := make(chan error,count)
	for i := 0; i < count; i++ { go func() { sequence,owner,err := c.reserveOfflineRequest(); if owner != "reader" && err == nil { err = ErrOfflineProtocol }; reserved <- sequence; errors <- err }() }
	seen := make(map[uint64]bool,count)
	for i := 0; i < count; i++ {
		sequence,err := <-reserved,<-errors
		if err != nil || sequence == 0 || sequence > count || seen[sequence] { t.Fatalf("invalid duplicate reservation: sequence=%d err=%v",sequence,err) }
		seen[sequence] = true
	}
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	c.request = ^uint64(0)
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	sequence,owner,err := c.reserveOfflineRequest()
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	final := c.request
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	if err != ErrOfflineProtocol || sequence != 0 || owner != "" || final != ^uint64(0) { t.Fatal("request overflow wrapped or changed owner authority") }
}

func TestOfflineAuthorityLatePrivateFactsMergeWithoutPublicApply(t *testing.T) {
	c := offlineAuthorityFixture(t)
	before := OfflineStatus()
	results := []offlineFreshDisableResult{
		{unregisterAttempted:true},
		{unregisterResolvedTrue:true},
		{verifiedRegistryAbsent:true},
		{},
	}
	done := make(chan error,len(results))
	for _,result := range results {
		go func(value offlineFreshDisableResult) { done <- c.completeFreshDisable(context.Background(),value,ErrOfflineUnknown) }(result)
	}
	for range results { if err := <-done; err != ErrOfflineUnknown { t.Fatalf("late private completion changed its error: %v",err) } }
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	receipt,after,confirmed := c.lastDisable,c.state,c.confirmedDisabled
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	if !receipt.unregisterAttempted || !receipt.unregisterResolvedTrue || !receipt.verifiedRegistryAbsent || receipt.disableAcknowledged || after != before || confirmed {
		t.Fatalf("late facts were lost or published: receipt=%+v before=%+v after=%+v confirmed=%v",receipt,before,after,confirmed)
	}
}

func TestOfflineAuthorityOptionalSupportFailuresRemainUnsupported(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"missing","insecure","throwing"} {
		t.Run(mode,func(t *testing.T) {
			c := offlineAuthorityFixture(t)
			window := js.ValueOf(map[string]any{})
			if mode == "insecure" { window.Set("isSecureContext",false) }
			if mode == "throwing" {
				window = js.Global().Get("Function").New("const w={};Object.defineProperty(w,'isSecureContext',{get(){throw new Error('private capture')}});return w").Invoke()
			}
			offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
			win = window
			offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
			supported := browserOfflineSupport() && offlineNativeReady()
			offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
			committed := offlineCommitConfigurationLocked(c,c.descriptor,supported)
			c.diag.DiagnosticRevision = 17
			offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
			ctx,cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
			defer cancel()
			_,err := offlineAdmitOperation(ctx,"disable")
			snapshot := OfflineStatus()
			offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
			revision,busy := c.diag.DiagnosticRevision,c.busy
			offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
			if !committed || supported || snapshot.Supported || !snapshot.Configured || err != ErrOfflineUnsupported || revision != 17 || busy { t.Fatalf("optional %s support failure escaped unsupported state: support=%v snapshot=%+v err=%v revision=%d busy=%v",mode,supported,snapshot,err,revision,busy) }
		})
	}
}
